source_of_truth_note: Fields marked "data_source": "REGISTRY" are copied verbatim (including apparent typos) from the real Physical Device Registry at backend/app/infrastructure/persistence/storage/ble_rffi_studio/registry/physical_units/*.json -- these are operator-declared, not independently verified. Fields marked "data_source": "PUBLIC_PRODUCT_CLASS" are well-established public facts about the named commercial PRODUCT LINE (e.g. a Shelly Plug is definitionally a mains relay), never about this specific physical unit's actual configuration. Fields marked "data_source": "NOT_DOCUMENTED" have no real source anywhere in this repository and must not be treated as known until a real inspection (firmware dump, chip marking read, protocol capture analysis) produces one. No field in this file was fabricated to fill a gap.
